scope_limitations: Ready means no scoped execution blocker found; it does not predict checker quality.
The cases and normalization are agent-authored; review is by a separate AI agent, not a human-approved or statistically independent holdout.
Preference gold is 13 pass, 6 fail, 1 needs_review because PF5H-04 is a supported conditional statement; this deviates from the 12/6/2 target and remains disclosed.
Several new cases are new instances of prior reasoning families; novelty_v1.json records overlap limits.
Checker support for conditional and qualitative assertions may yield review rather than semantic pass; measured outcomes must be reported unchanged.
Audit validates packet shape and projection only; no 40-case checker predictions were run in this challenge.
Local hashes are integrity metadata in a shared mutable directory, not external signatures or OS isolation.
